title: How One Text Tonight Starts Killing the Sin You've Been Managing
caption:
Same fight, different Tuesday.

You caught it again this week and told yourself the same thing you told yourself in March. That's not war. That's a truce you keep signing alone, and truces don't kill anything.

Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper, but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy. (Proverbs 28:13)

Tonight, before you go to sleep: pick one man who already has your number. Text him the actual word, not "pray for me, rough week." Lust. Laziness. The scroll. The second drink. Then send the same text again next week, even if the honest answer is still fighting it.

Say it enough times and it stops being able to hide.
